posts.script:
About six in ten remote jobs on our board... are open to people in just one country.
We counted.
If you live somewhere else, that's a lot of applications going nowhere.
So tell Yai-ray Careers where you live... and it shows you only the remote jobs that say they're open to you.
Every job opens its original posting. It's free, and we never charge you to apply.
Link in bio.

posts.title: Tip: read a remote posting in a minute
posts.hook: Read a remote posting in a minute, before you spend an hour on it.
posts.variable: Tip format: a checklist people save, against week 1's warning-sign tip.
posts.visuals: Five text slides: cover, three checks, closing slide.

slides.title: Read a remote posting in a minute
slides.sub: Three checks before you spend an hour on the form.

slides.title: Where you can apply from
slides.body: Countries, regions or time zones, in the location line or the text. No answer? Ask first.

slides.title: The pay
slides.body: If it's stated, check the currency and whether it's yearly, monthly or hourly.

slides.title: When it was posted
slides.body: Our board shows the date from the posting itself, not the day we found it.

slides.title: Tell it where you live
slides.sub: It shows only the jobs that say they're open to you.

posts.caption:
Read a remote posting in a minute, before you spend an hour on it.

Three checks: where you can apply from; the pay, its currency and whether it's yearly or hourly; and when it was posted.

Save this for your next application.

#remotejobs #jobsearch #jobtips #remotework
